subject: Quick status check + next step — Redwood pilot for transaction monitoring
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@midsizebank.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@midsizebank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Quick status check + next step — Redwood pilot for transaction monitoring

Hi Liam / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the deep dive into the transaction monitoring workflow and the approval path at Midsize Bank. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we stay aligned before EoQ: 

- What we heard: you need a lightweight pilot that can process ~1M monthly transactions with tokenized PII handling, audit logging, and the option to pin a model variant for deterministic outputs.
- What Redwood would deliver for the pilot: 30-day pilot environment, preconfigured routing for your EU/US traffic separation, per-route observability, and an SOC2 package for procurement.
- Timing ask from your side: decision window by the end of week of Nov 29 if we want to hit your internal December rollout targets.

Attached: redwood-midsizebank-map.pdf (architecture + pilot scope) and a quick action-items doc.

Proposed next steps:
1) I can send a short SOW + pricing spreadsheet (1–3 tiers) — will you own routing to procurement or should we loop in your vendor/sourcing contact?
2) If procurement needs it, Ben can join next week to walk pricing and pilot SLAs.
3) If helpful, we can provision a sandbox by Nov 30 for verification.

Are you still comfortable with the EoQ decision timeline? If priorities shifted, tell us the new target and we’ll adapt.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0113

Thanks for the recap, Priya.

This looks useful — I'm sharing with procurement and the fraud analytics lead. A couple of quick questions from the sourcing side:
- Can you confirm whether the pilot pricing covers data residency controls and audit log retention for 90 days?
- We typically need a short SOW for our contract team — can you send that?

Timing: we are aiming to get the procurement packet in front of legal by Dec 2, but there is some chance the budget owner will push decisions into early Dec. I'll confirm by EoW.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
VP Analytics, Midsize Bank
liam.oconnor@midsizebank.com
